title: Carl B. Cook
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Missionary to the Hamburg Germany Mission, 1976-78
Married Lynette Hansen, 1979, Ogden Utah Temple; Five children
BA in Business Marketing, Weber State College; MBA, Utah State University
Worked in real estate development for the Boyer Company for 26 years.
First Quorum of the Seventy 2011 - present
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
